narrative:
The model determined that you have a 34% chance of representing a bad credit risk. Because this probability exceeded the bank's acceptance threshold, your loan application was denied.

Unfortunately, this positive effect was outweighed by the other two factors. Taken together, these elements led the model to conclude that the overall risk was too high to approve the loan.
